if: the value of exempt supply under s.17(2) is being computed
activities or transactions specified in Schedule III are present
then: CONFLICT — both locally held sources exclude Schedule III activities from the value of exempt supply, but carve back differently. Source A carves back only paragraph 5 of Schedule III. Source B carves back paragraph 5 AND such transactions as may be prescribed in respect of clause (a) of paragraph 8. Neither is adopted here
note: The carve-back enlarges the exempt-supply value and so reduces admissible credit; the two sources therefore produce different numbers on the same facts. Source B footnotes the substitution to Act 8 of 2023 with effect from 1-10-2023.
